text:
maria: Starting a focused thread: route identity reconciliation + quota-safe backfill window. We need a plan to migrate old route_keys -> canonical_id with minimal billing drift.

jordan: fyi  we should keep reads consistent during migration, prefer read-layer shim not app changes.

maria: agreed. proposal: 1) add canonical_route_id field on ingest, 2) ingest emits legacy_id + canonical_id for 8w, 3) run a controlled backfill job ("spindle") to populate canonical for history, 4) read-shim does fallthrough logic.

oliver: for dashboards we'll add a compact MV that keys by canonical_id and falls back to legacy if missing to avoid heavy joins.

kevin: billing question: when canonical exists but points to a new tenant alias, how to attribute? we must freeze route->tenant mapping for the backfill snapshot.
sasha: we can snapshot route->tenant at backfill start into route_alias_hist( route_id, tenant_id, snapshot_ts ). Billing uses snapshot join during canary.

dara: perf: estimate for spindle: ~900k rows/hr per shard on current workers. For 8B rows that's ~9300 node-hours. We'll throttle.
jordan: let's run a parallel probe and publish spindle.estimate and spindle.progress metrics. throttles: db.qps_limit, worker_count, shard_blacklist.

maria: runbook notes: start at 10% pace for 48h, observe p95/p99 console queries, billing delta, and MV build time. If no regressions, double every 48h.

oliver: sample read-shim pseudocode: `if header.x-route-mode=='canonical' || record.canonical_route_id != null -> use canonical else -> fallback legacy`. We'll put it behind a feature flag.

kevin: audit: backfill should write migration_marker = 'spindle_v1' and migration_applied_ts so we can diff counts before/after. Also insert route_alias table: `route_alias(route_id, canonical_id, valid_from, valid_to, source)`.
sasha: dashboards: MV rename plan: create mv_canonical_routes (shadow), backfill materialization while reading from legacy mv, then swap atomic rename during low-traffic window. I'll coordinate owners.
jordan: skip lists: tenants with billing complexity (enterprises) should be excluded from initial canary. List to be curated by kevin.
dara: ingest-bot: spindle run tooling will include backoff on 429 and exponential retry for transient errors. We'll emit spindle.backoff_count and spindle.retry_rate.
ingest-bot: deploy-notice: ingest will ship dual-write flag in next canary build (sha 9a7b1c) scheduled 02:00 UTC.

maria: rollback criteria: if billing-attr mismatch >0.2% for canary tenants OR console query errors >0.5% we rollback and pause spindle. kevin to draft exact SQL for mismatch check.

kevin: drafting mismatch check: `SELECT count(*) FROM billing_snapshot b LEFT JOIN route_alias_hist r ON b.route_id = r.route_id WHERE b.tenant_id != r.tenant_id AND r.snapshot_ts = '<start_ts>'`  will refine.
sasha: timeline: canary next Tue on 5 tenants, widen to 30% two weeks after when metrics stable, full cutover 4w later. I'll post MV checklist here.
maria: action items: oliver -> read-shim PR, sasha -> MV swap checklist, kevin -> route_alias schema + tenant canary list, jordan -> spindle runbook with throttles/metrics, dara -> probe performance report.

kevin: add note: retention of route_alias_hist to 90d by default then reduce to 30d after stabilizing.
maria: thanks. I'll collect PR links and the runbook and post back. Closing thread for now :thumbsup:
